label: Core alpha (boosted-trees challenger)
blurb: A second challenger: each January gradient-boosted trees of depth two are fitted on every month known by then, the family scores as features and the next month's ranked return as the target, so the blend can bend (value only among quality names, say). Settings fixed before the first run; it replaces the baseline only if it wins in the early years, the later years and the holdout.
literature: Friedman (2001); Gu, Kelly and Xiu (2020); 100 trees, depth 2, rate 0.05, half the rows per tree
